restaurantName: La Mar Madrid by Gastón Acurio
address: Avenida del General Perón 36, Madrid, 28020, Spain
bio: This casual restaurant with a festive atmosphere (it even has Latin music playing) is located just a short hop from the Santiago Bernabéu stadium and marks the arrival in Madrid and Europe of the Gastón Acurio group, which has other similar establishments under the same La Mar concept in Santiago de Chile, Bogotá, Miami, San Francisco, and Dubai. You will find a bar area with high tables, designed for snacking and cocktail tasting, as well as another bar for cold dishes and a comfortable dining room with the kitchen at the back. What's on offer? A fairly comprehensive Peruvian-based menu, with starters and snacks, tiraditos, ceviches, grilled and wok-cooked dishes that reflect Creole, Chifa and Nikkei cuisine. Don't miss the delicious Nikkei ceviche, with bluefin tuna, cucumber, sesame oil...
pageTitle: La Mar Madrid by Gastón Acurio
